market_observations: No incumbent priced in the $5.99-$7.99 band - price gap
Multiple incumbents make unsupported emotional-trauma / nervous-system claims - credibility gap
Only ONE incumbent has a real safety protocol (No-Go Zones); rest ignore contraindications - safety gap
No incumbent is written by a credentialed clinician for the consumer market
DIY tools (tennis/lacrosse ball, foam roller, wall) get almost no coverage - cost barrier unaddressed

medical_evidence.MFR_chronic_low_back_pain: 8 RCTs n=375; significant pain + function improvement; GRADE moderate for pain/function, very low/quality of life. Frontiers in Medicine 2021
medical_evidence.MFR_chronic_neck_pain: 10 RCTs n=549; significant pain reduction p=0.03, d=0.86; PPT and ROM inconclusive. Physiotherapy 2023
medical_evidence.MFR_orthopaedic_systematic_review: 10 studies, mixed quality, PEDro 6-8/10; few conclusions drawable. PubMed 23725488
medical_evidence.mechanism: Mechanical 'breaking up adhesions' theory is NOT supported - hands cannot generate the force. Real mechanism is neurological (reduced muscle tone via sensory receptors)
medical_evidence.comparison_to_exercise: MFR did NOT outperform structured exercise for shoulder tendinopathy (n=72) - statistically non-significant on most outcomes
medical_evidence.contraindications_expert_consensus: open wounds (73%), fractures (84%); caution: local inflammation 97%, DVT 97%, bone infection 94%, myositis ossificans 92%

safety_rules_for_book: NEVER claim to cure, fix, or heal any condition
NEVER claim to diagnose or to replace medical care
NO 'release stored trauma' / 'detox' / 'reset your nervous system' language

Include a contraindication checklist BEFORE any technique (DVT, anticoagulants, osteoporosis, fracture, open wound/burn, active cancer, aneurysm, uncontrolled hypertension, acute flare, post-surgical)
Explicit red-flag chapter: radiating pain, numbness, weakness, bladder/bowel changes, night pain, unexplained weight loss, fever, progressive deficit -> stop and see a clinician
NEVER instruct rolling the cervical spine, front of neck/carotid, IT band, bony prominences, inner thigh/armpit neurovascular bundles
Frame as 'may help some people manage discomfort' + 'evidence is moderate for low back and neck pain, limited elsewhere'
Advise medical clearance for anyone with a diagnosed condition
No before/after medical imagery, no testimonials implying cure

beginner_author_assessment.critical_caveat: The 13.27 ratings/mo reading is a CEILING not a baseline. Presence in Kindle Unlimited inflates ratings relative to paid sales. A new $6.99 non-KU book should be planned at a fraction of that.
beginner_author_assessment.decisive_condition: You must have real subject-matter credibility or a credentialed reviewer. Without it this niche is unwinnable because the #1 rival advertises 'Reviewed by a Doctor of Physiotherapy'.
